narrative: The garden under a full moon. The orchard wall, the apple boughs, a bench. Paper on the bench, weighted with a stone. An inkhorn wedged in a knot-hole of the plank. Two quills beside the knot-hole.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Set the stone, and sat down to the sheet.

entities.name: the orchard scene
entities.context: In photo: Paper under a stone
